generalAbilities.name: Constant Pulse Radar
generalAbilities.description: The war machine can detect all creatures and objects within 100 feet of itself, treating hidden, invisible, and unobserved creatures as Concealed.

generalAbilities.name: Interstellar Comms
generalAbilities.description: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.

defensiveAbilities.name: Corpse Flower
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The war machine would be reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The war machine self-destructs, dealing 16d6 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 36 Reflex Saving Throw save) to all creatures in a 60-foot radius. For 1 minute after this ability is used, any creature that touches the war machine's remains is exposed to incredible radiation sickness.

defensiveAbilities.name: Psionic Flare
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet of the war machine Casts a Spell

Effect The war machine fires a focused lightning beam targeting only the triggering creature. If the creature fails its save, the spell becomes weakened. If the weakened spell requires a saving throw, the target uses the outcome one degree of success better than the result of its roll. If the weakened spell requires a spell attack, that attack roll takes a –4 circumstance penalty.

defensiveAbilities.name: Radio Silence
defensiveAbilities.description: 60 feet. Non-allied comm units and other computers don't function within the remote war machine's aura unless their operator succeeds at a computers|against:stealth|rollerRole:target check against the war machine's Stealth DC as an Interact action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swirling Shield
offensiveAbilities.description:
◆ to ◆◆◆

The remote war machine's tentacles surround it in defensive patterns. For 1 minute, it gains a number of reactions equal to the number of actions spent on Swirling Shield. These extra reactions can be used only for Psionic Flare or Reactive Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tentacle Flurry
offensiveAbilities.description: The war machine makes a tentacle Strike against up to four creatures in reach, rolling the attack and damage roll only once for all targets.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thermal Camouflage
offensiveAbilities.description: The war machine becomes Invisible for 1 minute or until it attempts to make a Strike.
